slides.title: A fair turn
slides.text:
Read a story about a fair plan.
Both can draw.
Point, tell or ask an adult to write.

slides.title: Ready to start
slides.text:
Choose: ready, rest or help.
You can point in a quiet way.
Start: I feel __.
Model: I feel ready.
You can pause with an adult.

slides.title: A fair plan
slides.text:
Two pupils want one pen.
A One keeps the pen all the time.
B Both have a turn.
Choose the fair plan. You can point.
Words: fair, turn, wait, help, both, grip.
Start: It is fair because __.
Model: It is fair. Both have a turn.

slides.title: Our story task
slides.text:
Read an easy-read story that teaches fairness.
Follow the story and the four pictures.
Show the fair plan.
In your book: give one line.
Words: fair, turn, wait, help, both, grip.
Start: It is fair because __.
Model: It is fair. Both have a turn.

slides.title: The fair turn story
slides.text:
Read or listen. Follow the pictures.
Both want the pen. One draws. One waits.
The next pupil has a turn and a grip.
Both can draw. That is fair.
Words: turn, help. Start: It is fair because __.
Model: Both have a turn.

slides.title: The story in order
slides.text:
1 Both want the pen.
2 One draws. One waits.
3 The next pupil has a turn and a grip.
4 Both have a turn. Both can draw.
Use the picture cards. Put them in order.
Words: first, next, last. Start: First __.
Model: First both want the pen.

slides.title: Show the fair plan
slides.text:
A One keeps the pen.
B Both have a turn and get the help they need.
Choose in a quiet way. Show a picture that fits.
Words: fair, turn, wait, help, both, grip.
Start: It is fair because __.
Model: It is fair. Both have a turn.

slides.title: My book line
slides.text:
Supported: pick fair words. Ask an adult to write.
Independent: make one line with the word bank.
Aspire: say why the grip helps.
In your book: give one line.
Words: fair, turn, wait, help, both, grip.
Start: It is fair because __.
Model: It is fair. Both have a turn.

slides.title: My quiet check
slides.text:
Show the fair part in the story.
Read or listen to your line.
Keep or change it after one next step.
Words: fair, turn, wait, help, both, grip.
Start: It is fair because __.
Model: It is fair. Both have a turn.

slides.title: My last step
slides.text:
Show your line to an adult in a quiet way.
Tell or point to one fair action.
You can ask an adult to write.
Words: fair, turn, wait, help, both, grip.
Start: It is fair because __.
Model: It is fair. Both have a turn.

slides.title: Fair turn words
slides.text:
fair: both get a turn and the help they need.
turn: a time when you can use the pen.
wait: let the other pupil have a turn.
help: make a task easier to do.
both: the two pupils.
grip: a thick part that helps hold the pen.
Start: It is fair because __. Model: Both have a turn.

slides.title: Adult support brief
slides.text:
Three to four pupils. Use Pupil number: ____ for each pupil.
10, 15 and 15 minute blocks; brief resets within.
Keep word bank, starter and model on EVERY task.
No public questions, cold calling or required reading aloud.
Exact scribe: pupil choice, private read-back, keep/change.
R: Voice + audience reply + one NS + own response.
E: actual banking. Record reading mode and actual help.
